verdict.rationale: The spec says each SKILL.md is YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown, and a skill can bundle scripts, references and templates in its folder. The CLI writes these files into plain project or global directories (`./<agent>/skills/`), symlinks them from a canonical copy, and installs them across 70+ agents. It can also install from a direct SKILL.md URL. Reuse across skills-compatible agents is an explicit design goal, and a community comment praises the agent-agnostic approach. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of manually copying a skill folder into a different harness and having it work unchanged.
